segments.he: וְהַלָּן בְּבֵית הַקְּבָרוֹת — כְּדֵי שֶׁתִּשְׁרֶה עָלָיו רוּחַ טוּמְאָה, זִימְנִין דִּמְסַכְּנִין לֵיהּ.
segments.en: Rabbi Shimon ben Yoḥai also says: «And one who sleeps in a cemetery» places himself in danger. The Gemara notes that this is the case if he does so «in order that a spirit of impurity will rest upon him,» as «sometimes» the evil spirits in the cemetery «endanger» the one who sleeps there.

moves.summary: danger is when he sleeps there to attract an impure spirit, which sometimes endangers him

edges.about: sleeping in a cemetery is dangerous when done to have an impure spirit rest on him
